entries.en: Nothin'... just that corporat-fuck that ran over my daughter – saw it with my own eyes, but... he pays every month. Pays a lot...
entries.ro: Nimic... doar corporatul ăla nenorocit care i-a dat peste fiica mea – am văzut cu ochii mei, dar... plătește în fiecare lună. Plătește mult...

entries.en: He'll pay when you redecorate the highway with his fuckin' brains...
entries.ro: O să plătească când redecorezi autostrada cu creierii lui de căcat...

entries.en: <mothertongue l="mex" m="Mira" b="" a=", if I kill him or sell him out to the badges, I won't make the rent. Besides, the <Rich color=\"MainColors.ActiveBlue\">pinche cabrón</>has connections to Grove Street."/>
entries.ro: <mothertongue l="mex" m="Mira" b="" a=", dacă-l omor sau îl vând gaborilor, nu ajung cu chiria. În plus, <Rich color=\"MainColors.ActiveBlue\">pinche cabrón</>ul are legături cu Grove Street."/>

entries.en: You think that's what Lisa would've wanted? Revenge? She wasn't like that...
entries.ro: Crezi că asta ar fi vrut Lisa? Răzbunare? Nu era genul...

entries.en: Papi, you're killin' me. Fuck the eddies. Be a man and drag that piece o' dog shit 'round the streets for everyone to see.
entries.ro: Papi, mă omori. Bag pula-n eddies. Fii om și târăște căcatul ăla de câine pe străzi, să-l vadă toată lumea.

entries.en: <mothertongue l="mex" m="¡nomás hazlo!" b="You mean 6th Street? See? You're gettin' everythin' mixed up now! Don't overthink this – " a=""/>
entries.ro: <mothertongue l="mex" m="¡nomás hazlo!" b="Adică 6th Street? Vezi? Acum amesteci totul! Nu te mai gândi atât – " a=""/>
